name: codex-goal-progress
description: A native progress bar for Codex Goals — see what is done, what is running now, and what comes next.

interface.shortDescription: See live step-by-step progress beside native Codex Goals.
interface.longDescription: Displays step-by-step and overall progress, elapsed time, and Goal-attributed Token usage right beside native Codex Goals, adapting to your theme, font size, layout, and language.
